capabilities: Add papers from URLs by downloading the PDF and creating a metadata note
Search the local library and SemanticScholar for papers
Check referenced paper details without leaving the tool
Display in-place citation popovers in paper PDFs with Obsidian PDF++
disambiguation: Not a study or flashcards tool; it manages an academic paper library with PDFs, metadata, and BibTeX.
extras: Exposes a JavaScript API (createPaperNoteFromUrl, isPaperInLibrary, openPaper) usable by other plugins and via Obsidian URIs; the PDF++ citation-popover feature depends on an upstream PR not yet merged, so users must install a modified PDF++ themselves.
motivation: The author wanted "a smooth experience that spans from paper reading, note taking, and reflection and synthesis", built on annotated bibliographies and Zettelkasten.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage an academic paper library with PDFs, metadata, citations, and BibTeX.

relations.evidence: This is used in conjunction with the amazing PDF Reader plugin tool Obsidian PDF++
optionally query and find papers from SemanticScholar directly if they are not in your library
The URI examples above require the Advanced URI plugin to be installed
citar: A reference manager work in EMACS.
elfeed: A RSS reader in EMACS.
elfeed-score: A RSS reader with scoring function in EMACS.
Some of the code is based on a previous project called paper-note-filer

summary: Research library manager that ingests paper PDFs from URLs, creates metadata notes, searches SemanticScholar, and shows citation popovers in PDFs.
